topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I walked through the door, the school's familiar smell bringing back a flood of memories. Seeing the familiar face at the front of the room, I felt a strange twist in my chest. My old teacher, here again, but this time for my child. I should have said something, should have found a way to explain. The years between us seem so thin, almost irrelevant, as I stand here, a parent now. I wonder if the lessons I learned are the ones I want my child to carry. There’s so much I wish I could change, so much I hope they won’t have to learn the hard way. But here we are, and perhaps that’s the cycle of life, a teacher in more ways than one.
